errors.text_span: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart showing the distribution of samples (percent) across two ambiguity-related variables, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity.”
errors.evidence: The chart is a single donut chart with seven distinct slices, not a two-level chart with separate inner and outer rings. Each of the seven slices has two color attributes (an inner color and an outer color) and one percentage value, representing a combination of the two variables.

errors.text_span: The outer ring contains four slices
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart has seven slices in total. The description falsely creates an 'outer ring' by cherry-picking four of the seven slices to fit its flawed structural interpretation.

errors.text_span: “Std: 0.0” in a dark teal-blue at approximately 49.0%
errors.evidence: There are two slices with the outer color 'dark teal-blue' (representing 'Std: 0.0'): one with a value of 49.0% and another with a value of 38.0%. The description incorrectly reports only one of these.

errors.text_span: “Std: 0.47” in a medium teal-blue at about 39.0%
errors.evidence: There are two slices with the outer color 'medium teal-blue' (representing 'Std: 0.47'): one with a value of 39.0% and another with a value of 14.2%. The description omits the 14.2% slice.

errors.text_span: “Std: 0.94” in a lighter cyan-blue at about 7.0%
errors.evidence: There are two slices with the outer color 'lighter cyan-blue' (representing 'Std: 0.94'): one with a value of 7.0% and another with a value of 47.7%. The description omits the 47.7% slice.

errors.text_span: The inner ring contains three slices
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. As part of the flawed structural interpretation, the description creates an 'inner ring' by cherry-picking three of the seven total slices.

errors.text_span: “Max: 1” in a medium light blue at about 47.7%
errors.evidence: There are three slices with the inner color 'medium light blue' (representing 'Max: 1'): one valued at 47.7%, another at 49.0%, and a third at 39.0%. The description incorrectly reports only one of these.

errors.text_span: “Max: 2” in a lighter blue at about 38.0%
errors.evidence: There are three slices with the inner color 'lighter blue' (representing 'Max: 2'): one valued at 38.0%, another at 7.0%, and a third at 5.0%. The description omits two of these slices.
